title: The Order of Norms: *a törvénynek alárendelt rendelet*
grammar: A participle with its complements before the noun
goal: I can say which norm ranks above another (*jogforrási hierarchia*, *alkotmányi szupremácia*, *megsemmisítés*).
I can describe a norm with a participle before the noun (*az Alaptörvényből levezetett*, *a törvénynek alárendelt*).
I can write one short sentence about a decree that conflicts with a statute.
